records.text: Hedge fund Ray Dalio has recommended holding up to 15% of your investments in gold. Based on the growing demand for gold, Deutsche Bank projects gold could reach $8,000 an ounce by 2031.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Hedge fund Ray Dalio has recommended holding up to 15% of your investments in gold. Based on the growing demand for gold, Deutsche Bank projects gold could reach $8,000 an ounce by 2031.

records.text: Deutsche Bank recently projected that gold could double in value by 2031. At the same time, the dollar continues to lose purchasing power.
